entries.summary: Fixed pacing mode bug where 'All' pace paused like 'Section' pace; now properly skips section-level and doc-level pauses when 'all' is selected

Add git worktree support to kickoff and branch scripts: every kickoff/branch now creates a linked worktree so parallel workstreams don't stomp on each other's checked-out branch. Added get_registry_root/get_registry_dir to route registry I/O to the primary worktree.

Complete partition-acceptance: machine-testable partition specs (AC, Artifact Type, How to Run in approach.md template + emergence guidance) and typed event log infrastructure (emit_event.py, get_events.py, lifecycle script integration, utils.emit, status display, implementation Rules 9-10, SKILL.md Event Log section). 251 tests.

Added machine-testable partition specs (Artifact Type, How to Run, Acceptance Criteria in approach.md) and typed event log infrastructure (emit_event.py, get_events.py, utils.emit). All lifecycle scripts now emit events; implementation agents emit task.complete and partition.complete per Rules 9-10.
Add spec front matter indexes, reset-boundary guidance, canon-summary routing hints, and regression checks for compact context reloads.
